integrity: A constructive all-order proof accompanies independently written Python and C++17 finite-instance checks, with their exact recorded outputs; experiments are not substituted for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite affine planes only. Proofs apply to non-Desarguesian planes; standalone calculations check only finite-field models. title: Uniform first-order recovery of affine planes from minimum-domination shattering
